title: Partner Pattern · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Partner Pattern · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a repeating two-shape pattern. One player draws the first two shapes and the partner adds the next two. All four shapes follow the agreed pattern. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Partner Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All four shapes follow the agreed pattern.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: All four shapes follow the agreed pattern.
